in_sanskrit.name: Bittu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Bite, Nibble
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bittu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Bittu is derived from the Hindi word 'bitana' which means 'to bite' or 'to nibble'. This name is often given to babies who are believed to have a strong personality, much like a bite or nibble that leaves an indelible mark.
